appraisal_events.evidence: Ce nom de Gilberte passa près de moi... transportant... la connaissance, les notions qu'avait de celle à qui il était adressé... tout cet inconnu, encore plus inaccessible et plus douloureux pour moi
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator's rapt, idealizing perception of the mere sound of Gilberte's name, cried out by her friend and freighted with an intimate life the narrator cannot access, elevates her into an object of intense desire and imagined prestige.

appraisal_events.evidence: elle me fit demander si je voulais compléter leur camp, et je jouai désormais avec elle chaque fois qu'elle était là
appraisal_events.explanation: Gilberte draws the narrator, previously an outside onlooker, into her circle of play, but she also remains the one who sets the terms, casually stating when she will or will not come, sometimes with visible indifference to his disappointment.

status_effects.explanation: Gilberte is intensely idealized and elevated in the narrator's perception, her mere name carrying overwhelming poetic and emotional value.
The narrator moves from watching Gilberte's circle from outside to actually playing with her group whenever she is present, a real crossing of the boundary into her circle.
Gilberte holds the leverage in the relation, deciding and announcing when she will or will not be available, at times with visible unconcern for the narrator's disappointment.
